a2f046f1bc9ca37d2adc.en: Conjunctions are joining words. They join two ideas into one longer sentence.
a2f046f1bc9ca37d2adc.id: Conjunction adalah kata penghubung. Kata ini menggabungkan dua ide menjadi satu kalimat yang lebih panjang.

32aeb4fc22d7f77f1918.en: And adds an idea. Or gives a choice.
32aeb4fc22d7f77f1918.id: And menambahkan ide. Or memberi pilihan.

ff8a670068ee80f6f75e.en: But shows a difference or a surprise.
ff8a670068ee80f6f75e.id: But menunjukkan perbedaan atau sesuatu yang mengejutkan.

849bb052aded98464c64.en: Because gives a reason. So gives a result.
849bb052aded98464c64.id: Because memberi alasan. So menunjukkan akibatnya.

cd2726bc38f8f039c013.en: When and if tell us about time, and about what must happen first.
cd2726bc38f8f039c013.id: When dan if memberi tahu kita tentang waktu, dan tentang apa yang harus terjadi lebih dulu.

f71a83b2c0bf5a9b18db.en: So shows a result. I was thirsty, so I drank some water.
f71a83b2c0bf5a9b18db.id: So menunjukkan akibat. I was thirsty, so I drank some water.

88a87ba20c8d738acbb1.en: Because gives the reason: we stayed inside because it was raining.
88a87ba20c8d738acbb1.id: Because menyebutkan alasan: we stayed inside because it was raining.

85cf1273730a73abed4f.en: And joins two ideas that go together: I like mangoes and I like bananas.
85cf1273730a73abed4f.id: And menggabungkan dua hal yang sejalan: I like mangoes and I like bananas.

34b5f60b49f68c6f700e.en: So shows what happened as a result. It was raining, so we took an umbrella.
34b5f60b49f68c6f700e.id: So menunjukkan apa yang terjadi sebagai akibatnya. It was raining, so we took an umbrella.

e102631327846b6c2c3f.en: But shows a difference between two ideas. I wanted to play, but the heat stopped me.
e102631327846b6c2c3f.id: But menunjukkan perbedaan antara dua hal. I wanted to play, but the heat stopped me.

4cbe77c5f39abdf2018d.en: Or gives a choice. You can have rice or noodles.
4cbe77c5f39abdf2018d.id: Or memberi pilihan. You can have rice or noodles.

08c9c106c35e52380854.en: Because gives the reason. Joko wore his coat because it was cold.
08c9c106c35e52380854.id: Because menyebutkan alasan. Joko wore his coat because it was cold.

0a4d3d90f2e88c3b92cc.en: Each joining word needs the right kind of ending. Because needs a reason, so needs a result, and if needs something that must happen first.
0a4d3d90f2e88c3b92cc.id: Setiap kata penghubung perlu akhir kalimat yang cocok. Because perlu alasan, so perlu akibat, dan if perlu sesuatu yang harus terjadi lebih dulu.

aa6d39c690f3bb9b5483.en: Because gives the reason. Bima practised because he wanted to win.
aa6d39c690f3bb9b5483.id: Because menyebutkan alasan. Bima practised because he wanted to win.

f3841f4b4c6c333042f0.en: You can write When I get home, I feed my cat. You can also write I feed my cat when I get home.
f3841f4b4c6c333042f0.id: Kamu bisa menulis When I get home, I feed my cat. Kamu juga bisa menulis I feed my cat when I get home.

7806dbddded9591d319c.en: So shows a result. Being hungry makes you eat, and a dark room makes you turn on the light.
7806dbddded9591d319c.id: So menunjukkan akibat. Karena lapar, kamu makan, dan karena kamar gelap, kamu menyalakan lampu.

b30cba4539b734db89f5.en: If you water the seeds tells us what must happen first. They will grow tells us the result.
b30cba4539b734db89f5.id: If you water the seeds memberi tahu apa yang harus terjadi lebih dulu. They will grow memberi tahu hasilnya.

90550e1f6c547ebbc3bd.en: But shows a surprise. Lena was nervous, but she still sang well.
90550e1f6c547ebbc3bd.id: But menunjukkan hal yang mengejutkan. Lena was nervous, but she still sang well.

4820e44b9b6885db0a51.en: After means the rain stopped first, and then we played outside.
4820e44b9b6885db0a51.id: After berarti hujan berhenti lebih dulu, lalu kami bermain di luar.

bcadc0448a62b3a3cd0f.en: I ate my lunch, and then I played football. And then shows the order of events.
bcadc0448a62b3a3cd0f.id: I ate my lunch, and then I played football. And then menunjukkan urutan kejadian.

fb3d69520c49e05fbcc8.en: Because gives the reason for taking an umbrella.

d09141d6cd63adae7de6.en: Because gives the reason for taking the umbrella.
d09141d6cd63adae7de6.id: Because menyebutkan alasan membawa payung itu.

33a5ee9f1d66c226078d.en: But shows the problem that stopped her.

bc82548c5dd38150a108.en: Until shows we wait for the rain to stop.
bc82548c5dd38150a108.id: Until menunjukkan bahwa kita menunggu hujan berhenti.

e2e13e25433e637d2469.en: Although it was late, we kept playing.
e2e13e25433e637d2469.id: Although it was late, we kept playing.

7830e17e04e5f7814c5f.en: Because gives a reason. But, although and yet show a difference.
7830e17e04e5f7814c5f.id: Because menyebutkan alasan. But, although, dan yet menunjukkan perbedaan.

a27b36b5303b79eb5638.en: But shows that tired did not stop the homework.
a27b36b5303b79eb5638.id: But menunjukkan bahwa rasa lelah tidak menghentikan pekerjaan rumah.

2edad300a46d4d05016f.en: But shows a contrast. Example: I like cake but I do not like pie.
2edad300a46d4d05016f.id: But menunjukkan perbedaan. Contoh: I like cake but I do not like pie.

9574b45fb8cce3761ee8.en: Because gives a reason. Or gives a choice. Example: Would you like tea or juice?
9574b45fb8cce3761ee8.id: Because menyebutkan alasan. Or memberi pilihan. Contoh: Would you like tea or juice?

a84ae27957a05d7c9dbe.en: Example: Do you want an apple or a banana? Or shows there are two options.
a84ae27957a05d7c9dbe.id: Contoh: Do you want an apple or a banana? Or menunjukkan ada dua pilihan.

17f2535298f86818d1a5.en: Because shows the reason, not the time. The reason we stayed inside is that it rained.
17f2535298f86818d1a5.id: Because menunjukkan alasan, bukan waktu. Kami tetap di dalam karena hujan.

4e956f0f86de3b8703c9.en: When tells us the time. Example: I smile when I see my friends.
4e956f0f86de3b8703c9.id: When memberi tahu waktu. Contoh: I smile when I see my friends.

6f7bc656a234e941e79f.en: But joins ideas that are different. And joins ideas that go together. Example: I like tea and I like milk.
6f7bc656a234e941e79f.id: But menggabungkan hal yang berbeda. And menggabungkan hal yang sejalan. Contoh: I like tea and I like milk.

86e66ee18da0db8b9643.en: If shows a condition. Example: We will play outside if it is sunny.
86e66ee18da0db8b9643.id: If menunjukkan syarat. Contoh: We will play outside if it is sunny.

9cfb29808e93a479a5c6.en: Because gives the reason I took the umbrella.
9cfb29808e93a479a5c6.id: Because menyebutkan alasan aku membawa payung.
